description: Live verification of every project-declared LP-holding account for the ASTEROID/XRP AMM: LP balance, share of LP supply, pro-rata implied XRP and ASTEROID, and a per-account control assessment derived from the master key, regular key and signer list at a validated ledger, plus an overall verdict. A closed signing path is an observation at one ledger, not a permanence guarantee, and the role of each account is an owner-confirmed project declaration.
name: verify_liquidity_lock
title: Verify ASTEROID LP-lock accessibility
